description: This file defines a LightningJS component named 'Loader' that displays animated circles as a loading indicator. It imports dependencies from '@lightningjs/blits' and includes properties, state management, lifecycle hooks, and methods for animation control.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A LightningJS component that renders animated circles to indicate loading status.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates an interval that toggles the alpha value of the loader to animate fade-in and fade-out.
